Definition: a Jeminite (collectively) or descendants of Jamin
BiblicalUsage: A Jeminite is a descendant of Jamin, named among the families of Israel in the wilderness. In Numbers 26:12, of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites. The fuller story is told on the Jamin profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: A Jeminite is counted among Israel's families, and I believe the naming shows God keeping track of every clan.
